job.job_description:
Key Qualifications

5+ years of software, cloud, DevOps, ML engineering, or related engineering experience, with meaningful hands-on experience supporting ML/AI workloads in production.
Demonstrable hands-on experience with the Google Cloud AI/ML stack, particularly production deployment and operationalization of ML workloads.
Strong Python development and automation skills.
Practical experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for ML or AI applications.
Hands-on knowledge of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes/GKE.
Experience with model deployment, versioning, monitoring, rollback, and lifecycle management.
Good knowledge of Vertex AI, or comparable managed ML platforms.
Understanding of machine learning workflows covering data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
Familiarity with Generative AI concepts such as LLMs, embeddings, RAG, vector databases, prompt-based applications, and agentic AI.
Understanding of production monitoring concepts including service health, model performance, drift, latency, resource utilization, and failure monitoring.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
Experience troubleshooting distributed cloud applications and production ML pipelines.
Comfortable working in an agile sprint environment with defined engineering tickets, code reviews, and release cycles.
Basic understanding of responsible AI, security, and data privacy, with the ability to identify and escalate potential concerns.
